pairs.target: guǎiguò yóu pù , lín zhào cái bǎ yìzhí zuàn zhe de shǒu zhāngkāi .
pairs.english: Only after turning past the oil shop did Lin Zhao open the hand she had kept clenched.
pairs.hanzi: 拐过油铺，林照才把一直攥着的手张开。

pairs.target: zhǎngxīn yāchū jǐdào zhǐjiǎ yìn , biānshàng hái zhān zhe zhúgān shàng de yìsī qīngpí .
pairs.english: Several nail marks were pressed into her palm. Along the edge there still clung a sliver of green skin from the bamboo pole.
pairs.hanzi: 掌心压出几道指甲印，边上还沾着竹竿上的一丝青皮。

pairs.target: tā běnlái kěyǐ děng .
pairs.english: She could have waited.
pairs.hanzi: 她本来可以等。

pairs.target: děng shěn yàn zhōu zǒu le , zài huíqù qiāomén .
pairs.english: Wait until Shen Yanzhou left, then go back and knock.
pairs.hanzi: 等沈砚舟走了，再回去敲门。

pairs.target: zhōu shěn rènde tā de jiǎobù , cóngqián tā huílái wǎn le , shǒu hái méi táiqǐ lái , ménshuān jiù yǐjīng xiǎng le .
pairs.english: Aunt Zhou knew her footsteps. In the past, when Lin Zhao came home late, the bolt would already rattle before she raised her hand.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶认得她的脚步，从前她回来晚了，手还没抬起来，门栓就已经响了。

pairs.target: kě zhōu shěn ruò wèn tā shì zěnme luòshuǐ de ne ?
pairs.english: But what if Aunt Zhou asked how she had fallen into the water?
pairs.hanzi: 可周婶若问她是怎么落水的呢？

pairs.target: tā shì zhe zài xīnlǐ shuō yíbiàn : shì tā tuī de .
pairs.english: She tried saying it once to herself. He pushed me.
pairs.hanzi: 她试着在心里说一遍：是他推的。

pairs.target: shuōwán le , zhōu shěn jiù dé tì tā shǒu zhe zhè jù huà .
pairs.english: Once she said it, Aunt Zhou would have to keep those words secret for her.
pairs.hanzi: 说完了，周婶就得替她守着这句话。

pairs.target: wǎnghòu zàijiàn shěn yàn zhōu , hái dé jì zhe zìjǐ shénme yě méi tīngjiàn .
pairs.english: Whenever she saw Shen Yanzhou again, she would have to remember she hadn't heard a thing.
pairs.hanzi: 往后再见沈砚舟，还得记着自己什么也没听见。

pairs.target: lín zhào bǎshǒu tiē huí yāo cè , shùnzhe shígōu jìxù zǒu .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao pressed her hand against her side again and kept walking along the stone gutter.
pairs.hanzi: 林照把手贴回腰侧，顺着石沟继续走。

pairs.target: tā pàn zhōu shěn xìn tā dehuà , yòu pàn zhōu shěn yíjù yě bié xìn .
pairs.english: She hoped Aunt Zhou believed him, and hoped she didn't believe a single word he said.
pairs.hanzi: 她盼周婶信他的话，又盼周婶一句也别信。

pairs.target: liǎngyàng tā dōu pàn , zǒu chūqù hěn yuǎn , háishì méi xiǎng chū nǎ yíyàng gènghǎo .
pairs.english: She wished for both. Even after walking a long way, she still couldn't think which would be better.
pairs.hanzi: 两样她都盼，走出去很远，还是没想出哪一样更好。

pairs.target: hé bù xiàyóu yǒu gè xiē dān de péngzǐ , dǐngshàng quē le liǎngpiàn wǎ .
pairs.english: Downstream from the landing stood a shelter for porters to rest, with two tiles missing from its roof.
pairs.hanzi: 河埠下游有个歇担的棚子，顶上缺了两片瓦。

pairs.target: zǎoshì de dànzi yǐjīng tiāo jìnchéng , pénglǐ zhǐ shèng yìtiáo shídèng hé yìzhī quēkǒu de cū wǎn .
pairs.english: The morning market loads had already been carried into town, leaving only a stone bench and a chipped earthenware bowl in the shelter.
pairs.hanzi: 早市的担子已经挑进城，棚里只剩一条石凳和一只缺口的粗碗。

pairs.target: lín zhào cóngqián tìrén sònghuò , yǔ jí shí zài zhèlǐ děng guò yìhuí .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao had made deliveries for people before and once waited here during a downpour.
pairs.hanzi: 林照从前替人送货，雨急时在这里等过一回。

pairs.target: tā zuò dào shídèng kào lǐ de nà tóu , zhōngyú néng bǎ jiǎo shēnzhí .
pairs.english: She sat at the inner end of the stone bench and could finally stretch out her legs.
pairs.hanzi: 她坐到石凳靠里的那头，终于能把脚伸直。

pairs.target: yāo shàng de bù hái zā zhe , biānyán bèi hàn jìnruǎn le .
pairs.english: The cloth around her waist was still tied, its edges softened with sweat.
pairs.hanzi: 腰上的布还扎着，边沿被汗浸软了。

pairs.target: tā jiěkāi yījīn kàn le yìyǎn , bùmiàn zhǐyǒu xiānqián nà diǎn ànhóng .
pairs.english: She opened her lapel to take a look. The cloth bore only the same little dark red spot.
pairs.hanzi: 她解开衣襟看了一眼，布面只有先前那点暗红。

pairs.target: dài niángzǐ shuō guò jìnchéng zhǎo rén kànkàn .
pairs.english: Mistress Dai had said to get someone to look at it in town.
pairs.hanzi: 戴娘子说过进城找人看看。

pairs.target: tā bǎ yījīn hé shàng , xiǎng xiān hēkǒushuǐ , zài xiǎng qù nǎlǐzhǎo rén .
pairs.english: She closed her lapel. She wanted a drink of water first, then she would think where to find someone.
pairs.hanzi: 她把衣襟合上，想先喝口水，再想去哪里找人。

pairs.target: shuǐnáng lǐ zhǐ shèng jǐkǒu .
pairs.english: Only a few swallows remained in the waterskin.
pairs.hanzi: 水囊里只剩几口。

pairs.target: tā yǎngtóu hē le yìkǒu ,
pairs.english: She tipped back her head for a swallow.
pairs.hanzi: 她仰头喝了一口，

pairs.target: pà pèngdǎo kōng wǎn , biàn shēnshǒu qù nuó , xiǎozhǐ de zhǐjié xiān kē le wǎn yán .
pairs.english: Wary of knocking over the empty bowl, she reached to move it, and her little finger's knuckle struck the rim first.
pairs.hanzi: 怕碰倒空碗，便伸手去挪，小指的指节先磕了碗沿。

pairs.target: wǎn zài yuánchù qīngqīng yìhuǎng , xiǎng le yìshēng .
pairs.english: The bowl rocked slightly in place and rang once.
pairs.hanzi: 碗在原处轻轻一晃，响了一声。

pairs.target: tā méi zài nuó , shōuhuí shǒu , dītóu nǐng gài .
pairs.english: She didn't move it again. She drew back her hand and looked down to screw on the cap.
pairs.hanzi: 她没再挪，收回手，低头拧盖。

pairs.target: yòu shì yìshēng .
pairs.english: There was the sound again.
pairs.hanzi: 又是一声。

pairs.target: tā tái yǎn shí , yìzhī dàn dé jīhū kànbújiàn de shǒu zhèng pèngshàng wǎn yán .
pairs.english: When she looked up, a hand so faint it was barely visible was just touching the bowl's rim.
pairs.hanzi: 她抬眼时，一只淡得几乎看不见的手正碰上碗沿。

pairs.target: nà zhī shǒu de xiǎozhǐ quán zhe , hé tā fāngcái kē shàngqù shí yìmúyíyàng .
pairs.english: The hand’s little finger was curled, exactly as hers had been when she struck the bowl a moment ago.
pairs.hanzi: 那只手的小指蜷着，和她方才磕上去时一模一样。

pairs.target: shǒu bújiàn le , wǎn hái zài qīngqīng huàngdòng .
pairs.english: The hand vanished. The bowl was still rocking slightly.
pairs.hanzi: 手不见了，碗还在轻轻晃动。

pairs.target: tā de liǎngzhīshǒu dōu hái wò zhe shuǐnáng .
pairs.english: Both her hands were still gripping the waterskin.
pairs.hanzi: 她的两只手都还握着水囊。

pairs.target: qú lǐ nà zhī tuī shítou de shǒu , tā zǒngyǐwéi shì zìjǐ téng hūn le tóu .
pairs.english: She had always thought the hand that pushed the stone in the channel was something the pain had made her imagine.
pairs.hanzi: 渠里那只推石头的手，她总以为是自己疼昏了头。

pairs.target: nàshí jiǎo báchūlái le , shítou luò huíqù , shénme yě kànbùqīng .
pairs.english: Her foot had come free then, the stone had fallen back, and she couldn't see anything clearly.
pairs.hanzi: 那时脚拔出来了，石头落回去，什么也看不清。

pairs.target: kě yǎnxià rìtou zhàozhe dèngzǐ , wǎn jiù zài yǎnqián , nà yì shēngxiǎng hé fāngcái yíyàng qīngchǔ .
pairs.english: But now the sun shone on the bench, the bowl was right before her eyes, and the sound was as clear as before.
pairs.hanzi: 可眼下日头照着凳子，碗就在眼前，那一声响和方才一样清楚。

pairs.target: lín zhào bǎshǒu shēnguòqù , yòu yòng zhǐjié pèng le pèng wǎn yán .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao reached over and touched the rim again with her knuckle.
pairs.hanzi: 林照把手伸过去，又用指节碰了碰碗沿。

pairs.target: tā děng le piànkè , zhǐ tīngjiàn héshuǐ pāiàn .
pairs.english: She waited a moment and heard only the water lapping against the bank.
pairs.hanzi: 她等了片刻，只听见河水拍岸。

pairs.target: tā bǎ shuǐnáng bào huí huáilǐ .
pairs.english: She hugged the waterskin against her chest again.
pairs.hanzi: 她把水囊抱回怀里。

pairs.target: ruò zhè jiùshì juéxǐng , chénglǐ zǒng yǒurén néng shuō qīng shì zěnmehuíshì .
pairs.english: If this was awakening, someone in town must be able to explain what was happening.
pairs.hanzi: 若这就是觉醒，城里总有人能说清是怎么回事。

pairs.target: kě tā xiān xiǎngdào de shì shuí huì wèn tā de míngzì .
pairs.english: But the first thing she thought of was who would ask her name.
pairs.hanzi: 可她先想到的是谁会问她的名字。

pairs.target: tā gé zhe yīliào mō dào qìzhǐ de yìjiǎo , zhǐjiān zài nàlǐ tíng le tíng , yòu shōuhuí lái .
pairs.english: Through her clothes she felt a corner of the contract. Her fingertip paused there, then withdrew.
pairs.hanzi: 她隔着衣料摸到契纸的一角，指尖在那里停了停，又收回来。

pairs.target: hé shàng yǒu chuán kàoàn , shāogōng jiào rén dì lǎn .
pairs.english: On the river a boat drew in to shore, and the boatman called for someone to pass the mooring line.
pairs.hanzi: 河上有船靠岸，艄公叫人递缆。

pairs.target: lín zhào tīng zhe nàbiān yìshēng jiē yìshēng dì dāying , xiǎngqǐ chū chéng de lù yě yǒurén zǒu , tiāntiān dōu zǒu .
pairs.english: Hearing one reply after another from over there, Lin Zhao remembered that people took the roads out of town too. They did it every day.
pairs.hanzi: 林照听着那边一声接一声地答应，想起出城的路也有人走，天天都走。

pairs.target: tā yuán xiǎng zài zhè chénglǐ zǎn gòu yìjiān wūzi de qián .
pairs.english: She had meant to save enough for a room in this city.
pairs.hanzi: 她原想在这城里攒够一间屋子的钱。

pairs.target: rújīn zhēn yào wǎng wài zǒu , xiān dé zhǎo yìtiáo zìjǐ zǒu dé dòng de lù .
pairs.english: Now if she really meant to leave, she first needed to find a road she could manage on her own.
pairs.hanzi: 如今真要往外走，先得找一条自己走得动的路。
